Fixes uploads failing with "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'getDirectory')" when featherdrop is opened over plain HTTP.

## Fixed

- **Uploads now work without OPFS (e.g. over plain HTTP).** Browser-side encryption streamed the ciphertext through the Origin Private File System, which browsers expose only in a **secure context** (HTTPS or localhost). On plain HTTP `navigator.storage` is undefined, so the upload crashed before it started with `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'getDirectory')`. It now falls back to encrypting in memory and uploading that for files up to **500 MB**; larger files report a clear message. For big files, the browser clipboard, and streaming downloads, open featherdrop over **HTTPS** — see the Reverse Proxy section of the README.
